raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advances the matching MCore main pin and submodule from `a98aed553e25b4e86c59f50be54ac0ea4227b442` to `1e3c0c62fbb79c26d083f506f7da46f5f7add49e`.

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/a98aed553e25b4e86c59f50be54ac0ea4227b442...1e3c0c62fbb79c26d083f506f7da46f5f7add49e) includes 13 commits covering GTP partitioning, FSDP layout/communication, inference fixes, precision-aware recomputation, and minimum-memory DSA kernels. No dependency metadata changed upstream; CUDA-container `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` resolved 345 packages with no lockfile changes. The bump also updates Gemma4 to import `te_checkpoint` from its defining `megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine` module.

Validation: all-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed; main pin and gitlink match, and `.dev.commit` is unchanged. Commits are signed and signed off. The first full CI attempt reproduced an import error during unit-test collection; after the import fix, all 89 Gemma4 modeling unit tests passed locally, including BF16/FP8/FP4 checkpoint dispatch. Independent review approved the scoped repair.

Requested CI: full L0/L1/L2 on H100 and GB200, plus standard gates. On repaired head `5e44f4e4fe4f5a7a8ce0377287412e26c7163e1f`, [CICD NeMo 38538237937](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38538237937) attempt 1 passed with all four full configure outputs true, all four unit jobs and all 119 functional jobs green: H100 L0/L1/L2 = 30/26/17; GB200 = 12/21/13. Installation, copyright, docs preview and secrets checks passed. Link check passed on attempt 2 after confirmed transient GitHub 503/504 responses. Build/release also passed. Full L0/L1/L2 validation and standard non-review gates are proven on this exact head; current-head human approval is still required.

Cause **2. No bug on either side, just incompatibility**: [Megatron-LM #7709](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7709), verified merge commit `7a4047543fd0e8917b6806230d2d0d7dcb122b82`, intentionally removed the incidental `moe_layer.te_checkpoint` re-export while preserving its canonical definition. The repair changes only the import source and preserves existing checkpoint behavior.

Because this PR includes a Bridge code change, current-head human approval and resolved review threads are required before merge.
